items.headline: Vanderbilt holds off Mississippi State to win its first SEC game 25-23
items.description: — Vanderbilt withstood a comeback attempt by Mississippi State and won 25-23 on Saturday. It’s the Commodores’ first Southeastern Conference win of the year, and it snaps a five-game losing streak.
